text:
lina: Heads-up — after the smem tiling PR (r3245) I see a perf regression on the paged-attn fused kernel for seq_len=2048, bs=8 on A100. ~18% slower for forward pass. Anyone else?

max: saw it locally, thought it was noise. can you paste the perf numbers?

lina: pasted below (ns/op averages from perf-bot). forward: before 34.2ms -> after 40.4ms, backward: 78.5ms -> 92.1ms. throughput drop ~16-18%. config: smem_tile=64, pipe_stages=3, warp_sched=balanced.

sophie: what changed in smem allocator? r3245 changed per-warp padding and reduces sharedmem per-block to improve occupancy for kv-cache. Might be more bank conflicts for this kernel.

max: repro script: ./bench/paged_fused_attn.py --model gpt2-xl --seq 2048 --bs 8 --quant none

lina: perf-bot output:

```
perf-bot: build r3244 (good)
  forward mean: 34.2ms
  backward mean: 78.5ms
perf-bot: build r3245 (current)
  forward mean: 40.4ms
  backward mean: 92.1ms
SMEM usage per-block: before 48KB -> after 36KB
Occupancy: before 0.55 -> after 0.79
Memory BW util: before 72% -> after 89%
```

ryan: odd — occupancy improved but memory BW increased; sounds like we moved from compute-bound to memory-bound by changing tile sizes.

sophie: agree. try increasing tile to 96 or re-enable per-warp padding. Also check whether KV prefetching changed behaviour — prefetch can create more concurrent loads increasing BW.

max: tested tile=96 quickly: forward 35.1ms, backward 81.0ms — almost back to baseline. tile=96 increases SMEM per-block to 44KB and occupancy 0.63.

lina: is tile=96 safe memory-wise for larger models? for batch=16 maybe OOM.

sophie: maybe add an adaptive tiling heuristic: pick larger tile for long sequences when batch small, otherwise smaller tile to keep memory low. We have a batching heuristic module — can add a rule: if seq_len > 1024 and batch <= 8 -> tile=96 else tile=64.

max: also think about pipeline stages: pipe_stages=2 had lower latency vs 3 in a quick test. Try pipe=2 with tile=64: forward 36.0ms.

lina: next steps: max to prepare a micro-benchmark matrix (tile x pipe x bs x seq) and a perf-bot run. sophie to prototype adaptive heuristic in scheduler. ryan to add perf counters in nightly to capture bank conflict stalls and DRAM BW.

perf-bot: scheduled nightly matrix run: /jobs/eng-runtime/bench/paged_fused_matrix_r1823456790

lina: thanks — can we aim to revert padding change if heuristic not ready by next release? :thumbsup:

max: yeah I'll have PR with benchmark + patch by tomorrow.

sophie: I'll open issue + draft for heuristic.

ryan: I'll add counters.

lina: cool, closing for now. :eyes:
